# This file is automatically generated from cmake.toml - DO NOT EDIT
# See https://github.com/build-cpp/cmkr for more information

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)

if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_BINARY_DIR)
	message(FATAL_ERROR "In-tree builds are not supported. Run CMake from a separate directory: cmake -B build")
endif()

set(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT OFF)
if(CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR)
	set(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT ON)

	# Bootstrap cmkr and automatically regenerate CMakeLists.txt
	include(cmkr.cmake OPTIONAL RESULT_VARIABLE CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
	if(CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
		cmkr()
	endif()

	# Enable folder support
	set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY USE_FOLDERS ON)

	# Create a configure-time dependency on cmake.toml to improve IDE support
	set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS cmake.toml)
endif()

# Options
option(NXTCACHE_BUILD_DUMPER "" ON)

# vcpkg settings
# Static deps (sqlite3, zlib, bzip2) get baked into NXTCache.dll so it ships as
# a single file. Use the -md variant to keep the dynamic CRT — required for
# loading from the JVM (which links /MD) without CRT heap-ownership conflicts.
set(VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET x64-windows-static-md)

if(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD)
    set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
endif()
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

project(NXTCacheLibrary
	LANGUAGES
		CXX
	VERSION
		0.1.0
	DESCRIPTION
		"C++ library for reading the RuneScape NXT cache (sqlite-backed jcache files)"
)

if(MSVC)
    add_compile_definitions(_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS NOMINMAX)
    add_compile_options(/utf-8)
endif()

if(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT AND NOT CMKR_DISABLE_VCPKG)
	include(FetchContent)
	# Fix warnings about DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP
	if(POLICY CMP0135)
		cmake_policy(SET CMP0135 NEW)
	endif()
	message(STATUS "Fetching vcpkg (2025.06.13)...")
	FetchContent_Declare(vcpkg
		URL
			"https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/archive/refs/tags/2025.06.13.tar.gz"
		SUBBUILD_DIR
			"CMakeFiles/vcpkg-subbuild"
		SOURCE_DIR
			vcpkg
		BINARY_DIR
			"CMakeFiles/vcpkg-build"
	)
	FetchContent_MakeAvailable(vcpkg)

	if(CMAKE_HOST_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL Darwin AND CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES STREQUAL "")
		set(CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES ${CMAKE_HOST_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR} CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
	endif()
	include("${vcpkg_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/buildsystems/vcpkg.cmake")
endif()

# Packages
find_package(unofficial-sqlite3 REQUIRED)

find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED)

find_package(BZip2 REQUIRED)

find_package(LibLZMA REQUIRED)

include(FetchContent)

message(STATUS "Fetching nlohmann_json (v3.11.3)...")
FetchContent_Declare(nlohmann_json
	GIT_REPOSITORY
		"https://github.com/nlohmann/json.git"
	GIT_TAG
		v3.11.3
	GIT_SHALLOW
		ON
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(nlohmann_json)

# Target: NXTCache
set(NXTCache_SOURCES
	cmake.toml
	"src/c_api/nxtcache_c.cpp"
	"src/c_api/nxtcache_c.h"
	"src/config_types/InterfaceTypes.cpp"
	"src/config_types/InterfaceTypes.h"
	"src/config_types/ModelType.cpp"
	"src/config_types/ModelType.h"
	"src/config_types/ScriptVarType.cpp"
	"src/config_types/ScriptVarType.h"
	"src/config_types/SpriteType.cpp"
	"src/config_types/SpriteType.h"
	"src/config_types/Types.cpp"
	"src/config_types/Types.h"
	"src/core/Archive.cpp"
	"src/core/Archive.h"
	"src/core/CacheSource.h"
	"src/core/ConfigProvider.h"
	"src/core/DbRowProvider.h"
	"src/core/FileHeader.h"
	"src/core/Index.cpp"
	"src/core/Index.h"
	"src/core/RSBuffer.h"
	"src/core/RSCache.cpp"
	"src/core/RSCache.h"
	"src/core/TypeMappings.h"
	"src/dumper/Json.h"
	"src/gzip/compress.hpp"
	"src/gzip/config.hpp"
	"src/gzip/decompress.hpp"
	"src/gzip/utils.hpp"
	"src/gzip/version.hpp"
	"src/maps/MapSquare.cpp"
	"src/maps/MapSquare.h"
	"src/network/HttpClient.cpp"
	"src/network/HttpClient.h"
	"src/network/Js5Archive.cpp"
	"src/network/Js5Archive.h"
	"src/network/Js5Cache.cpp"
	"src/network/Js5Cache.h"
	"src/network/Js5Compression.cpp"
	"src/network/Js5Compression.h"
	"src/network/Js5Config.cpp"
	"src/network/Js5Config.h"
	"src/network/Js5Index.cpp"
	"src/network/Js5Index.h"
	"src/network/Js5Socket.cpp"
	"src/network/Js5Socket.h"
	"src/render/IconRenderer.cpp"
	"src/render/IconRenderer.h"
)

add_library(NXTCache SHARED)

target_sources(NXTCache PRIVATE ${NXTCache_SOURCES})
source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${NXTCache_SOURCES})

target_compile_features(NXTCache PUBLIC
	cxx_std_20
)

target_include_directories(NXTCache PUBLIC
	src
)

target_link_libraries(NXTCache PUBLIC
	unofficial::sqlite3::sqlite3
	ZLIB::ZLIB
	BZip2::BZip2
	LibLZMA::LibLZMA
	nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json
	ws2_32
	winhttp
)

set_target_properties(NXTCache PROPERTIES
	WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS
		ON
)

# Target: nxtcache-dumper
if(NXTCACHE_BUILD_DUMPER) # build-dumper
	set(nxtcache-dumper_SOURCES
		cmake.toml
		"src/dumper/Json.h"
		"src/dumper/main.cpp"
	)

	add_executable(nxtcache-dumper)

	target_sources(nxtcache-dumper PRIVATE ${nxtcache-dumper_SOURCES})
	source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${nxtcache-dumper_SOURCES})

	target_compile_features(nxtcache-dumper PRIVATE
		cxx_std_20
	)

	target_include_directories(nxtcache-dumper PRIVATE
		src
	)

	target_link_libraries(nxtcache-dumper PRIVATE
		NXTCache
		nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json
	)

	get_directory_property(CMKR_VS_STARTUP_PROJECT DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR} DEFINITION VS_STARTUP_PROJECT)
	if(NOT CMKR_VS_STARTUP_PROJECT)
		set_property(DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR} PROPERTY VS_STARTUP_PROJECT nxtcache-dumper)
	endif()

endif()
